title: Baltic Coast · Kühlung Hills · Wismar
slogan: A 117 km loop out of Bad Doberan minster roads

scenicChapters.title: Baltic Coast Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 16 km this is Baltic Coast Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Rerik cliffs photo stop → Neukloster inland sweep
scenicChapters.narrative: 40 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

storyWas: Salt air first, soft hills after coffee.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 42 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
